caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular grandfather clock with a wooden case, colored in shades of brown with detailed wood grain and decorative inlays. The base of the clock features a large circular motif with a star pattern in the center and is bordered with small, gold-colored corner designs. The midsection of the clock includes a vertically oriented oval inlay and a small, central, oval medallion with a floral design, also based in brown tones with some additional lighter or gold accents around these features. The clock face is encased in the upper portion of the clock and bordered by an arched, ornate frame with gold-toned trim. The clock face itself is white with black Roman numerals and two black decorative clock hands, and it is set into a rectangular panel with additional ornate designs. Above the face is a semicircular decorative section containing a painted scene with a pink tufted element and gray details. The topmost part of the clock is adorned with three gold finials and two outward-curving scrolls made of wood, flanking the central finial. The background is a plain off-white with visible pencil sketches and annotations, including some geometric and floral shapes drawn faintly around the perimeter. Handwritten notes and measurements are scattered near the edges, and the name "John Dieterich" is inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Tall Clock
